name: Workspace boundary guard
summary: Block native file edits whose resolved target escapes the active project workspace.
description: A bounded Claude Code PreToolUse hook for Write, Edit, MultiEdit, and NotebookEdit that checks lexical containment and the canonical location of the nearest existing ancestor before allowing a file mutation.
refuses: It does not expand the workspace boundary from a repository file, tool payload, or agent-authored exception.
It does not follow a symlink chain whose canonical existing ancestor escapes the workspace.
It does not claim to replace operating-system sandboxing or prevent a filesystem race after evaluation.

entrypoints.purpose: Verify lexical and canonical containment for native file mutation targets without modifying the filesystem.
